query: hMTNR1A P48039, hMTNR1B P49286, hGPR50 Q13585 (human proteome, each verified against its own UniProt record)
database: 11 metazoan reference proteomes (UniProt reference sets, completeness checked against proteomeCount)
outcome: hits in every species at 24-30% identity; identity alone uninformative at class-A GPCR distance
32 reciprocate to a melatonin receptor across 9 species; 0 of 8 C. elegans candidates do (all reciprocate to neuropeptide or dopamine receptors)

query: MTNR profile (368 positions, 35 sequences: the 32 RBH set + 3 human references)
outcome: C. elegans ceiling 232.1 (SER-2, a tyramine receptor); no hit distinguishable from the aminergic background

database: Dmel, Pcau, Myes, Spur, Cint, Nvec, Lana, Bflo
outcome: TECHNICAL LIMIT: in 3 of 8 species the held-out true ortholog scores BELOW that species' best non-ortholog (Dmel 215 vs 232 at rank 12; Nvec 231 vs 275; Pcau 266 vs 293). The profile cannot exclude an ortholog at the C. elegans ceiling of 232.
pcdr-1 ranks 35/64/43; 71 distinct worm proteins outscore it on at least one query. These are the taxa the first tree panel was missing.

melatonin clade 100/100 (3 human + 5 zebrafish only); pcdr-1 outside it, in its own 5-tip clade at 99.7/100 attached to neuropeptide receptors. 27 of 32 invertebrate melatonin RBH calls fall outside the melatonin clade - the RBH screen was unreliable at this distance.

UNINFORMATIVE AS RUN: the constrained search put 45 tips inside the forced group, so it tested only that the taxa share some clade. dLogL 3.25, p-AU 0.178 at gt0.1; at gappyout the constrained search returned the ML tree. Superseded by the exclusive form.

query: 178-taxon panel (round 1 + all 71 worm proteins outscoring pcdr-1)
outcome: No C. elegans sequence inside the melatonin clade at either trim level. pcdr-1 is NOT among the 48 worm genes in the nearest clade to it. pcdr-1's own 5-tip clade 99.8/100 (gt0.1), 100/100 (gappyout). CAVEAT: melatonin clade itself is 100/100 at gt0.1 but only 43.5/30 at gappyout in this expanded panel.

query: exclusive constraint (pcdr-1 + melatonin clade monophyletic, all 120 taxa named)
outcome: REJECTED both trim levels, all four tests. dLogL 102.8 (gt0.1) / 98.7 (gappyout).

query: calibration: same constraint applied to cel_dop-1 and cel_ser-2
outcome: dLogL pcdr-1 104.8, dop-1 105.6, ser-2 111.0. pcdr-1 indistinguishable from dop-1 (0.8 units, within seed noise). The rejection measures panel geometry, not anything specific to pcdr-1.

query: hGPR52, hGPR21 (forward direction, to test orphan-family membership independently of the tree)
outcome: Clade-mates rank at or near the top of their own proteomes: Spur 1/1 both queries (170/179 bits, reciprocal best hits), Dmel 1 for GPR52, Lana 2, Pcau 4-5, Cvir 12-34. pcdr-1 itself ranks only 15-16, so it is NOT an RBH for this family either - the orphan family is corroborated off-tree, but pcdr-1's membership in it rests on the tree alone.

query: LBA control 1: pcdr-1 deleted from the 178-taxon panel, tree rebuilt
outcome: The orphan family (GPR52, GPR21, Spur, Dmel, Pcau, Cvir, Lana) is EXACTLY monophyletic at 97.7/93 with pcdr-1 absent - nothing else falls inside. pcdr-1 was therefore neither holding the group together nor destabilising it. Melatonin clade unchanged, 8 tips 100/100.

query: LBA control 2: site-heterogeneous model on the 178-taxon panel
method: IQ-TREE LG+C20+F+G, PMSF, guide tree -ft output/tree2/gt0.1.treefile
outcome: pcdr-1 STAYS inside the orphan family (8 tips, 96/99) under the model chosen to resist long-branch attraction - the placement does not collapse, so it is not an attraction artifact. Melatonin clade 8 tips 100/100, pcdr-1 outside. Caveat: single run, not replicated over seeds.

method: robust z (median/MAD) on terminal branch lengths
outcome: CORRECTION to the dop-6 characterisation: pcdr-1 is 2.652 subs/site, z = 1.5, rank 10 of 178, median 0.852 - NOT an extreme outlier in this panel. The z = 17.4 figure from ../dop6_c24a8_6 was relative to an aminergic-only panel (median 0.348) that excluded pcdr-1's actual relatives. Longest here is PCDRfam_Cint_H2XQ43 at 4.334.

query: MEL_verified.hmm (354 positions, the 8 verified melatonin-clade members only - no RBH set)
outcome: Lamprey is a clean positive: A0AAJ7T8G6 (544 bits, "Melatonin receptor type 1A-A-like") and A0ACM8ASR7 (451, "type 1B-A-like"), both RBH to human MTNR1A at 429/377 bits. Every other lineage tops out at 134-189 (Cint 169, Bflo 179, acorn worm 183, echinoderms 171-185, Nvec 168, molluscs 148-181) - indistinguishable from class-A background. Family confirmed to the base of vertebrates, not before.

query: MEL_verified.hmm walked through lamprey (2 Pmar sequences added, profile rebuilt)
outcome: Invertebrate scores moved by a few bits only (Cint 169->172, Bflo 179->185) - no hidden invertebrate ortholog emerged, so the invertebrate negative is not simply a reach problem. LIMIT: the profile is still vertebrate-anchored by construction (lamprey is a vertebrate), so a sufficiently divergent invertebrate member could escape it. Structural search (foldseek) is the axis that would not inherit this bias - NOT RUN.

query: 258-taxon panel: full aminergic backbone (minus the nematode neuropeptide expansion) + 88 above-floor orphan hits + pcdr-1 + melatonin family incl. lamprey + 3 human neuropeptide roots
method: MAFFT L-INS-i, trimAl gt0.1 + gappyout, IQ-TREE LG+F+I+R7, -B 1000 --alrt 1000
outcome: POSITIVE CONTROL PASSES: the melatonin family is exactly monophyletic, 10 tips 100/100, at BOTH trims - so this alignment does resolve this depth and the rest is interpretable. PCDR-1 sits in an 8-member PROTOSTOME clade at 99.7/100 (gt0.1) and 99.8/100 (gappyout): pcdr-1, Dmel DopEcR, Pcau, Cvir, Lana, 3x Lpol. Adding 2 hemichordate gives 10 tips at ~95/99. The node that adds hGPR52+hGPR21 is 36.2/91 and 3.2/52 - it collapses. 63 of 88 above-floor hits fall OUTSIDE the family clade, so the ADRB2 floor was porous and the 93-hit figure was mostly aminergic bleed-through.

query: exclusive constraint: the claim as written (7 corroborated seed members + pcdr-1 monophyletic, all 258 taxa named) + two calibrations
outcome: REJECTED at both trims. dLogL 856.1 (p-AU 1.35e-90) and 708.9 (p-AU 5.13e-31). CALIBRATED: forcing the melatonin clade, which independent evidence says is real, costs only 0.58 and 5.86 log units (p-AU 0.566, 0.383), so the test is not rejecting everything. Forcing the PROTOSTOME clade costs 0 and is the best tree in the set (p-AU 1.0), slightly beating the unconstrained ML search - a constrained search escaping a local optimum. CONCLUSION: PCDR-1 + GPR52/GPR21 as a clade is formally rejected; the protostome clade is positively supported.

query: GPR88 (Q9GZN0, resolved by query) vs the orphan7 family profile and MEL profiles; then a 3-ortholog GPR88 profile across every proteome
outcome: GPR88 is NOT in PCDR-1's family, tested BOTH ways: 14.5 bits vs orphan7 (rank 691/707 in human), and GPR52/GPR21 score BELOW THRESHOLD against the GPR88 profile - a symmetric negative. GPR88 is detectable only in jawed vertebrates (Hsap 790.9, Mmus 792.0, Drer 528.8); every other lineage incl. lamprey 62.1 and hagfish 63.9 sits in the 31-128 class-A background. NO C. elegans ortholog (best 53.1, Q22188; blastp agrees at 53.9 bits / 24.9% id). LIMIT: profile built from 3 jawed-vertebrate sequences, the most narrowly anchored in this project, so the invertebrate negative is method-limited. Lead not followed: Dmel Moody (68.3) and an amphioxus moody-like (83.9) are the top invertebrate hits by both methods.
